facts.text: KITCHEN by Osman Sezener retains its Michelin Star in 2026, the third consecutive year.
facts.excerpt: KITCHEN proudly retains its Michelin Star in 2026, marking the third consecutive year.

facts.text: KITCHEN serves contemporary Aegean and Anatolian cuisine led by chef Osman Sezener.
facts.excerpt: Our renowned chef, Osman Sezener, immerses diners in the vibrancy of contemporary Aegean and Anatolian cuisine.

facts.text: KITCHEN uses herbs, salad greens and vegetables sourced from the hotel's own gardens and local farms.
facts.excerpt: along with herbs, salad greens and vegetables sourced from the hotel’s own gardens and local farms.

facts.text: The Trattoria partners with Michelin-starred chef Stefano Ciotti to showcase Italian cuisine, starting in the 2024 season.
facts.excerpt: Starting in the 2024 season, The Trattoria is partnering up with Michelin-Starred Chef Stefano Ciotti, who is taking the helm to showcase the flavors of Italian cuisine.

facts.text: The Trattoria hosts live experiences with artists from the music, art and fashion worlds.
facts.excerpt: hosting live experiences with renowned artists from the music, art and fashion worlds.

facts.text: DAHA Mehmet Akdag offers Turkish dining inspired by Anatolia, with regional ingredients and fire cooking.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Anatolia, the menu blends regional ingredients, fire cooking, and refined techniques, marrying heritage with modern Turkish gastronomy.

facts.text: Inari Kujira is a Japanese-inspired dinner pop-up at Morena, in collaboration with an Istanbul Asian Fusion concept.
facts.excerpt: transforming the relaxed all-day dining menu at MORENA into an elegant Japanese-inspired dinner menu as “Pop-up Inari Kujira”

facts.text: Morena is a beachside restaurant offering diverse global flavors.
facts.excerpt: MORENA is a lively beachside restaurant that excites by offering diverse global flavors.

facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool and garden lounge that ends at the sea.
facts.excerpt: At the base of the resort lays an infinity pool and garden lounge which ends at the sea overlooking the magnificent curve of the peninsula.

facts.text: The Beach Club offers private beach access, a jetty, private cabanas and towel service.
facts.excerpt: Guests can take advantage of the hotel's private beach access, a jetty, private cabanas, a Beach Bar menu tailored to al fresco dining, and towel service.

facts.text: The Beach Club hosts exclusive weekly beach parties with DJs and entertainers.
facts.excerpt: plays host to exclusive weekly beach parties, bringing the world’s hottest DJs and entertainers

facts.text: Suites feature private plunge pools and terraces.
facts.excerpt: Spacious, light-filled suites feature the additional luxury of private plunge pools and terraces.

facts.text: The four-bedroom private villa has its own swimming pool and sauna area.
facts.excerpt: the exceptional four-bedroom private villa offers complete privacy, with its own swimming pool and sauna area.

facts.text: Guest room bathrooms have marble, deep soaking tubs, monsoon rain showerheads and Le Labo bath products.
facts.excerpt: luxury marble bathrooms with deep soaking tubs, monsoon rain showerheads, and custom Le Labo bath products.

facts.text: Rooms have warm wood finishes and airy fabrics that give a beach house feel.
facts.excerpt: Warm wood finishes and airy fabrics lend a beach house feel to the generous, 5-star guest rooms

facts.text: The spa includes a Turkish Hammam, a salt treatment room and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Turkish Hammam, salt treatment room, and sauna

facts.text: The spa is open to day guests as well as hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: offers easy access for both in-house and day guests.

facts.text: The gym offers a Pilates room, an indoor cycling studio and a yoga terrace with SUP Yoga.
facts.excerpt: Work on your stamina in the Pilates room or challenge your body in the Indoor Cycling Studio.

facts.text: The hotel is 3 kilometers from Yalikavak Marina at the western point of the Bodrum peninsula.
facts.excerpt: 3 kilometers from Yalikavak Marina at the western point of the Bodrum peninsula

facts.text: The hotel offers 24-hour room service.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour Room Service

facts.excerpt: SEASONALLY CLOSED
